title: cyperus oblongus var. ruwenzoriensis
intro: Cyperus oblongus var. ruwenzoriensis, commonly known as East African flat sedge, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in African folk medicine, offering various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of East African flat sedge are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
